body:
Sam Ops: landed FRA inbound - 30 H200s. Vendor emailed: 2 units failed vendor QC (power fault) and one serial unlisted. AWB: NLH-550077. Can we do a split ship?
Ravi SCM: contract replacement SLA = 5 bd. Vendor offering 36h express for +€3,900 or we pull loaners. Need quick call: cost vs risk.
Helga (NordLog): NordLog update  AWB NLH-550077 contains 27 good + 3 flagged. Flagged serials: H200-3001 (power fault), H200-3002 (power fault), H200-300X (serial mismatch). We can split-ship remaining stock tomorrow AM if you confirm holds.
Marta Crossdock: crossdock: please add `QUARANTINE` tags to flagged units. If you don't, they'll be embedded in pallet B and sent out. Also vendor changed consignee VAT on manifest - customs may pause replacements.
Sam Ops: recommend split: ship 27 -> staging-FRA, quarantine 3. Canary needs 6 H200s; losing 3 would force a rollback. Check loaner pool first.
Ravi SCM: loaner pool: FRA has 1 H200, AMS has 2 (transit ~14h). Not enough for full canary. Express seems necessary. @cost-bot can you run fast approval?
cost-bot: cost-bot: express quote (€3,900) < risked SLA exposure. Auto-approve up to €4,500 for EU express RMA. Cost center: INFRA-GPU-EU. Attach invoice when received.
Helga (NordLog): scheduling express pickup for flagged units now. Expected replacement AWB: NLH-550077-R (will post tracking). Prepaid return RMA: RX-NLH550077. Vendor notes replacements shipped blank (no imaging).
Marta Crossdock: applying `QUARANTINE` and `HOLD-DOCS` to the 3 flagged. Moving 27 units to `staging-fra-ready`. Manifest excerpt:
```
awb,unit_count,status
NLH-550077,27,ready-to-stage
NLH-550077,3,quarantine
```
and serial snippet:
```
unit,serial,location,tag
H200,H200-2988,staging-fra,ready
H200,H200-2989,staging-fra,ready
...
H200,H200-3001,crossdock-fra,quarantine-power-fault
H200,H200-3002,crossdock-fra,quarantine-power-fault
H200,H200-300X,crossdock-fra,quarantine-serial-mismatch
```
Sam Ops: noted. SRE will hold canary rollout for 8h and run smoke with reduced capacity. If replacements miss ETA we escalate vendor rep and open penalty channel.
Helga (NordLog): posted provisional tracking at ts 3750012580. ETA replacements to FRA depot 36-48h after pickup. Will email corrected consignee VAT to avoid customs.
Ravi SCM: thanks all. We'll not pull loaners to avoid draining AMS pool. Proceed with vendor express. Keep thread open until replacements received and RMA labels scanned. (Sam Ops reaction: :white_check_mark:)
